local log = require("devtools.logs.logger").universal()
local uv = vim.uv

local function get(host, port, path, on_data, on_done)
    local tcp = assert(uv.new_tcp())
    local headers_done = false

    tcp:connect(host, port, function(err)
        if err then
            tcp:close()
            return on_done(err)
        end

        tcp:write(
            "GET " .. path .. " HTTP/1.1\r\n" ..
            "Host: " .. host .. ":" .. port .. "\r\n" ..
            "Accept: text/event-stream\r\n" ..
            "Connection: close\r\n" ..
            "\r\n"
        )

        tcp:read_start(function(read_err, chunk)
            if read_err then
                tcp:close()
                return on_done(read_err)
            end

            if not chunk then
                tcp:close()
                return on_done()
            end

            if not headers_done then
                local _, body_start = chunk:find("\r\n\r\n", 1, true)

                if body_start then
                    headers_done = true

                    local body = chunk:sub(body_start + 1)
                    if #body > 0 then
                        on_data(body)
                    end
                end

                return
            end

            on_data(chunk)
        end)
    end)

    return tcp
end
